disclosures.frame_label: a uniform random sample of 2000 PWG headwords (seed 20260726)
disclosures.frame_note: Drawn uniformly from all 109,050 PWG headword groups with an explicit seed, so it is reproducible and — unlike the H1455 frame — **not** selected for DCS attestation. This is the frame that answers "what share of PWG is attested at all?".
disclosures.frame_note_long: The frame is a **uniform random sample of 2000 PWG headword groups (seed 20260726)** drawn from all 109,050 groups parsed out of `csl-orig/v02/pwg/pwg.txt`. It carries no DCS-attestation precondition, so its lemma-level rate is an unbiased estimate of PWG as a whole.
